visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, brown hair wearing a beige turtleneck shirt sits in front of a wooden door. She holds a large cardboard box and gestures with her right hand while speaking directly to the camera. (2) Close-up shots display five different packages of Atsugi 'Control Color Stockings' in various colors: Pink, Yellow, Mint, Blue, and Lavender. The packaging is primarily white with colored labels. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street in Japan during the day. Many pedestrians walk along a wide sidewalk lined with trees and modern buildings, including a prominent red storefront. (4) The woman is seen at a subway station platform, wearing a black top. She looks into the camera, and yellow safety lines and platform doors are visible behind her. (5) A series of close-ups shows the woman applying and wearing different stockings on her arms and legs to demonstrate the color-correcting effects. Text overlays indicate the specific color being tested. (6) In a brightly lit indoor room, the woman, a man in a black shirt, and a small child sit at a light-colored table, interacting with a blue plastic toy train set.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: Instagram@kaoru_0409. [Subtitle]: 我又買了超酷的東西. (2) [Subtitle]: 開箱日本最近話題度超高的. [Slogan]: コントロールカラーストッキング. [Subtitle]: 人手一雙的粉底絲襪. (3) [Subtitle]: 很多日本女生穿短裙短褲時會穿膚色絲襪. (4) [Subtitle]: 可能是為了禮貌 有安全感 或是讓肌膚看起來更無暇. (5) [Slogan]: Atsugi. [Subtitle]: 這款修飾肌膚瑕疵的粉底絲襪 一推出就在日本迅速爆紅. (6) [Subtitle]: 一共有5色 分別是 粉紅色 增添血色感 適合皮膚偏白的人. (7) [Subtitle]: 黃色 修飾膚色不均. (8) [Subtitle]: 薄荷綠 遮蓋泛紅. (9) [Subtitle]: 我有皮膚病腳上較多紅斑 這款修飾的非常好又很自然. (10) [Subtitle]: 拯救了不敢露腿的我 一試穿我就去囤了10包. (11) [Subtitle]: 藍色 提亮膚色 提升透明感. (12) [Subtitle]: 薰衣草色 修飾蠟黃 這款是我覺得最顯白的喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 每一款穿起來都非常自然 彈性也很夠. (14) [Subtitle]: 沒想到飾底乳的概念能用在絲襪上 佩服日本人的創意. (15) [Subtitle]: 我是在東京育兒的RU醬 歡迎追蹤我 看更多日本生活和最新日本情報.

(2) A sharp, mid-frequency rustling sound of paper and plastic is heard as items are manipulated. The BGM remains steady with a clear 4/4 beat. (3) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition, while the narrator continues at a high speech rate explaining product features. (4) Faint, low-frequency ambient city hum and distant chatter are audible during an outdoor clip, but the studio-clean narration remains dominant. (5) Small mechanical clicks and soft percussive thuds occur as toys are handled. A male voice and a child's voice offer short, low-arousal responses in the background. (6) The audio ends with a concluding statement from the narrator as the music fades slightly.
